Six-Method Comparison (pbest-fixed MOPSO seed)

MOPSO, the full PCN family (Original PCN, PCN with evolutionary buffer init., Guided PCN -- all three at max_size=750, pbest-fixed MOPSO seed where applicable -- the best single-factor ordering result found: 5/6 settings show a clean variation2-over-variation1 win including gs, vs. every combo tried on top of it making some other setting worse), MOPSO-AMS (2x MOPSO's evaluation budget, I=200 T=200), and CAPQL (MORL baseline: obs-norm on, alpha=0.05, start_steps=10000, total_steps=300000, 10 seeds). Across all six demand settings, 10 runs per method per setting.
